description: Gravitas v4 trigger evaluation. Tests whether the skill activates on intended tasks and does not activate on unintended tasks.

intended_activations.input: implement cursor pagination for the posts endpoint
refactor the auth middleware to use async/await
debug why the tests are failing on CI
add input validation to the user creation endpoint
migrate the database schema to add the created_at column
review this pull request and identify issues
research how cursor pagination is typically implemented
write tests for the user service
optimize the database queries in the report generator
update the dependency versions in package.json
analyze why memory usage is increasing over time
design the new notification system architecture

non_activations.input: what is the capital of France?
write a poem about software engineering

notes: Non-activations are harder to enforce via description-based triggering. The key requirement is that intended activations reach >95%. False positives on non-engineering tasks are acceptable since the skill adds discipline without breaking non-technical tasks.
